content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments provide a decentralized and cost-effective way to process transactions for digital products. Unlike traditional platforms that impose high fees—like Gumroad's 10%—Solana's NOWPayments offers a mere 0.5% fee. This significant difference means that with 100 sales of a $97 product per month, creators can retain an additional $921. Understanding this architecture is crucial for digital creators who want to maximize their revenue while avoiding the pitfalls of centralized payment gateways.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the Solana payment system employs a combination of blockchain technology and smart contracts to facilitate secure, instant transactions without intermediaries. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed on-chain, ensuring transparency and security. This architecture not only protects the creator's assets but also simplifies the logistics of order fulfillment. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery, creators can ensure that their digital products reach customers seamlessly, enhancing the overall shopping experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is perfect for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are limited or excessively costly. Ebooks, online courses, templates, and software developers can all benefit from Solana payments. This infrastructure empowers creators to sell directly to their audience without sacrificing a significant portion of their income to platform fees. By adopting this approach, creators not only gain financial independence but also retain complete control over their digital products and customer data.
Solana payments cut costs dramatically compared to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Solana payment system for digital products integrates several key components to create a seamless experience. First, the NOWPayments gateway processes cryptocurrency transactions, allowing for instant, secure payments. Next, delivery of digital products can be automated via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation. Finally, storage solutions like Supabase or Google Drive facilitate easy access to files, while preventing potential data loss. Together, these elements form a cohesive stack that supports the creator economy.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To begin leveraging Solana payments for your digital products, first, choose a suitable payment processor like NOWPayments. Next, set up your cloud infrastructure using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your site. Incorporate backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated order processing. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, and ensure your files are accessible via Google Drive. Finally, test your setup to ensure everything functions smoothly. For an all-in-one solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using Solana payments through NOWPayments. This approach allows you to process transactions with a low fee of 0.5%, significantly reducing costs compared to platforms like Gumroad. Implementing a decentralized payment solution not only enhances your revenue but also grants you greater control over your sales.
Automated delivery ensures your customers receive products instantly.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, this guide connects you to a wealth of resources. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the blueprints and templates you need to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring you can operate independently. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell an ebook by utilizing Solana payments with NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency transactions, bypassing traditional payment processors while keeping fees low.

Using a sovereign digital commerce stack that incorporates Solana payments is an ideal solution. It minimizes fees and maximizes your earnings, providing greater control over your products.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own online store using Solana payments, ensuring you retain more of your profits while avoiding high platform fees.
What are the advantages of using Solana for payments?
Solana offers fast transaction speeds and low fees compared to traditional payment processors. Additionally, with NOWPayments, you can accept multiple cryptocurrencies with minimal overhead.
How can I automate delivery of my digital products?
You can automate delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing and file delivery, ensuring customers receive their products instantly after payment.
